"import os
import csv
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

# Load the CSV data
csv_path = 'load_01.csv'
data = []
with open(csv_path, 'r', newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        data.append({
            'case': row['case'],
            'load_factor': float(row['load_factor']),
            'cycles': int(row['cycles'])
        })

# Compute required summary stats from data
n_cases = len(data)
load_values = [d['load_factor'] for d in data]
cycle_values = [d['cycles'] for d in data]

load_max = round(max(load_values), 2)  # 2.35 expected
load_mean = round(sum(load_values) / n_cases, 1)  # 1.7 expected
total_cycles = sum(cycle_values)  # 87563 expected

# Verify computed values match required ones
print(f"N cases = {n_cases}")
print(f"load max = {load_max}")
print(f"load mean = {load_mean}")
print(f"total cycles = {total_cycles}")
print(f"Data rows: {len(data)}")
print("First few rows:", data[:3])

# Build presentation
prs = Presentation()

# Slide 1: Title slide
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])  # Title slide layout
title = slide1.shapes.title
subtitle = slide1.placeholders[1]
title.text = "Engineering Load Test Report"
subtitle.text = "Fatigue Load Factor Analysis"

# Slide 2: Data slide with table
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])  # Title and Content
title2 = slide2.shapes.title
title2.text = "Data"

rows = len(data) + 1  # header + data rows
cols = 3
left = Inches(0.5)
top = Inches(1.5)
width = Inches(9.0)
height = Inches(5.0)

table_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, left, top, width, height)
table = table_shape.table

# Header row
headers = ['case', 'load_factor', 'cycles']
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    cell = table.cell(0, i)
    cell.text = h
    for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in paragraph.runs:
            run.font.bold = True
            run.font.size = Pt(14)

# Data rows
for r_idx, record in enumerate(data, start=1):
    table.cell(r_idx, 0).text = str(record['case'])
    table.cell(r_idx, 1).text = str(record['load_factor'])
    table.cell(r_idx, 2).text = str(record['cycles'])

# Slide 3: Summary slide with bullets
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])  # Title and Content
title3 = slide3.shapes.title
title3.text = "Summary"

body = slide3.shapes.placeholders[1]
tf = body.text_frame
tf.clear()

bullets = [
    f"N cases = {n_cases}",
    f"load max = {load_max}",
    f"load mean = {load_mean}",
    f"total cycles = {total_cycles}"
]

for i, text in enumerate(bullets):
    if i == 0:
        p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    else:
        p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = text
    p.level = 0

# Slide 4: Next steps slide
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])  # Title and Content
title4 = slide4.shapes.title
title4.text = "Next steps"

body4 = slide4.shapes.placeholders[1]
tf4 = body4.text_frame
tf4.clear()

next_steps = [
    "Review outliers in high load_factor cases",
    "Validate cycle counts against raw test logs",
    "Schedule follow-up fatigue testing",
    "Update design margin analysis"
]

for i, text in enumerate(next_steps):
    if i == 0:
        p = tf4.paragraphs[0]
    else:
        p = tf4.add_paragraph()
    p.text = text
    p.level = 0

# Save the presentation
output_path = 'report.pptx'
prs.save(output_path)
print(f"\nPresentation saved to {output_path}")
print(f"Number of slides: {len(prs.slides)}")"
